Rank 1 Melee Technique

  • Ki Cost: 8 Ki
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: Self (10-foot cone)
  • Chargeable?: No
  • Duration: Instantaneous

You perform a devastating round house kick with enough force to send a shockwave away from you. Creatures in a range must make a Dexterity Saving Throw, taking your Unarmed Strike Damage Die + 2d6 Bludgeoning Damage and being Launched 10 feet on a failed save. On a successful save, they take half damage and are not Launched.
